costs: one-way rate = (COST_BPS_PER_SIDE + SLIPPAGE_BPS) / 1e4 on every traded dollar, including the overlay's own scalar turnover; cash earns 0

inputs.base_holdings: DATA_DIR/aegis_pi.db paper_positions (shares, opened_at, closed_at) + paper_book_decisions (asof_date, decided_utc) for base_book_id
inputs.digests: OPTIMUS_LEDGER_DIR/digest/world_digest_<YYYYMMDDTHHMMSSZ>.json (world_digest.out_dir); fields themes[].tone.fear_greed and themes[].tone.n_independent_sources; dry runs ignored

licence: PRODUCT_EXPERIMENT (internal simulation only: no broker, no order, no LLM authority)
mapping: F = sum_i n_i * fear_greed_i / sum_i n_i over themes with numeric tone.fear_greed, n_i = max(1, n_independent_sources); fewer than MIN_THEMES -> EMPTY. B = median F over the previous BASELINE_N valid digests stamped strictly before this digest; fewer than BASELINE_MIN -> NO_BASELINE. d = F - B; raw = 1 - SLOPE * max(0, -d - DEADBAND); scalar = clip(round(raw / STEP) * STEP, SCALAR_MIN, SCALAR_MAX). Any degradation -> 1.0.
name: NEWS_OVERLAY_v1
objective: terminal NAV of the overlay vs its twin under the BALANCED personality (same notional, same costs); read daily, by date block, raw lines first
rebalance: a book re-targets at a session close only when its scalar changed or the base book's holdings changed; otherwise it holds its shares
timing: decision time = DECISION_ET America/New_York on session t; read only digests stamped strictly before it; newest older than MAX_AGE_HOURS -> STALE; fill = close of t (the next close after the digest's own stamp); the scalar earns close t -> close t+1
twin: the base book at scalar 1.0: identical names, relative weights, re-target moments and cost rate; only the scalar differs
